title: Nepal Charges Chinese Construction Firm for Corruption Over Airport
content: Nepal’s anti-graft watchdog said the state-owned Chinese firm and Nepali officials colluded to inflate the costs of an international airport in Pokhara.

title: In Thailand and Cambodia, Taking Shelter (Again) as Fighting Reignites
content: Hundreds of thousands of people fled a deadly border conflict, the authorities said, some sheltering at a racetrack in Thailand and some near temples in Cambodia.

title: Canada’s Northwest Territories Diamond Mines Are Closing
content: After decades of growth driven by diamond mining, Canada’s Northwest Territories are facing the closure of three major mines and wondering: What’s next?

title: Another Front in the War in Ukraine: Who Gets to Claim a Famed Artist?
content: Looking to shake off Moscow’s cultural influences, Kyiv has been seeking to highlight the Ukrainian roots of Kazimir Malevich, a renowned avant-garde painter.

title: With Cheap Tickets and Lax Etiquette, a Theater Builds an Older Fan Base
content: The Hollywood Classic cinema in Seoul is popular in a country where 70-year-olds now outnumber people in their 20s.

title: Between Pakistan and Afghanistan, a Trade War With No End in Sight
content: After deadly cross-border military clashes, the Pakistani and Afghan governments have locked their populations in a trade war threatening the livelihoods of millions.

title: One Hundred Schoolchildren Released After Kidnapping in Nigeria
content: The abduction of over 260 children from a Catholic school last month was the latest in a recent spate of kidnappings in the country.

title: All 187,460 Miles of Road That Led to Rome, Mapped
content: A digital atlas of ancient Rome’s highways and byways reveals a road network that was more extensive than thought.

title: Honduras Issues Warrant for Juan Orlando Hernández
content: The attorney general said he had asked Interpol to detain Juan Orlando Hernández, who was freed from a U.S. prison last week.

title: The Second ‘China Shock’
content: Chinese exports are flooding the developing world, and the social consequences are bound to be profound.

title: 7.6-Magnitude Earthquake Near Japan Triggers Tsunami Warning
content: The 7.6-magnitude quake struck in waters off Aomori Prefecture on Japan’s main island, Honshu. It triggered a tsunami warning, which was later lifted.

title: Marooned Off the English Coast: Lots of Bananas
content: Containers of bananas, avocados and plantains fell off a cargo ship off the Isle of Wight. A soggy fruit harvest ensued.

title: Love Letters From a Chinese Jail
content: The torn pieces of paper by Gao Zhen, a renowned artist jailed in China, show family portraits, memories of New York and expressions of faith. To his wife, they are love letters.

title: Dogs in Kimonos: Japan Reinvents a Children’s Holiday With Pets in Mind
content: A traditional Japanese festival is being adapted for poodles and Pomeranians, amid a booming pet industry and a dearth of children.

title: جنود القاعدة الأميركية في التنف يشاركون السوريين فرحة عيد التحرير
content: مقطع يصور احتفال بعض الجنود الأميركيين داخل قاعدة التنف العسكرية في ريف حمص الشرقي بذكرى تحرير سوريا وسقوط نظام بشار الأسد.
